purpose: Design reference for the O-Horse breed system: available breed categories, behavior classes, stat rules, appearance rule sets, and coat-part texture options.
implementation_notes: display_category is what the O-Horse screen shows. behavior_class is what OHorse uses for passengers, sprint handling, armor/movement behavior, and feathering rules.
Runtime coat rendering currently uses 24 active coat slots from OHorse#getHorseVariantTexture. Higher coat ordinals used by breed rules wrap back into those 24 slots with floorMod.
OHorseModel.Variant declares additional texture names, and texture assets may exist, but they are not necessarily reachable through the current OHorse#setVariant path unless code changes.

Current setMarkingByBreed implementation appears to call setVariant instead of setOverlayVariant for the common branch of Ardennes, Welsh, and Oldenburger marking rules. This JSON lists the intended/current rule family, but that implementation detail may deserve a code review.

coat_and_marking_sensitive_eye_chance.boosted_condition: white, cream, mostly-white, bald, or overo-style horses get higher blue/green eye chances
coat_and_marking_sensitive_eye_chance.normal_condition: all other horses usually roll dark brown through gold/dark blue, with rare blue/green/heterochromia/red outcomes

any_except_fjord.summary: Any active coat except Fjord-style coloring.

browns_roans_greys.summary: Mostly browns, roans, and greys with a small chance of lighter/other colors.

blacks_and_greys.summary: Mostly black/grey coats with a small chance of other colors.

bays_with_any_chance.summary: Any non-Fjord color sometimes, usually bay-family colors.

warmblood_bays.summary: Any non-Fjord color sometimes, usually bay-family colors plus silver.

duns_or_bays.summary: Any non-Fjord color sometimes, usually dun or bay-family colors.

akhal_teke_light.summary: Usually cream or other light colors.

soldier_or_connemara_black_grey.summary: Black/grey leaning, but other colors remain possible.

often_socks_or_face.summary: Usually socks, face markings, silver overlays, or none; sometimes any marking.

mostly_none_or_small.summary: Usually no marking, sometimes small markings, rarely any marking.

fjord_none_or_small.summary: Usually no marking, rarely small markings or any marking.

usually_solid_30_any.summary: Usually solid, with 30% chance of any marking.

almost_always_solid_2_any.summary: Almost always solid, with 2% chance of any marking.

small_markings.summary: Usually small markings, socks, or none.

warmblood_solid_or_socks.summary: Usually solid or socks, sometimes any marking.

usually_solid_20_any.summary: Usually solid, with 20% chance of any marking.

shire_small_markings.summary: Usually small markings or socks, with 7% chance of any marking.

usually_solid_5_any.summary: Usually solid, with 5% chance of any marking.

small_markings_30_any.summary: Usually small markings or socks, with 30% chance of any marking.

boulonnais_solid_or_dapple.summary: Usually solid or dapple, with 2% chance of any marking. Current code has a gap for rolls between 0.02 and 0.30.
